summary: StudentPRSelector is a web page and related code for a Student Placement Request selection and history interface in HSPnet. It combines ASP.NET Web Forms, user controls, JavaScript, server-side business logic, and AJAX components. The main purpose is to let users view and interact with a student's placement selection and preference history, including profile details, history of placement preferences, and mechanisms for validating and submitting placement requests.
purpose: Provide an interactive web interface for: (1) displaying student profile details, (2) managing student placement selection and preference history, (3) supporting related business logic, validation, and UI workflows for Student Placement Requests in HSPnet.

workflows.name: Student Placement Request Selection
steps: Page loads; validates URL hash using Hashing.ValidateURLHash.
Student profile header is bound with student's details and email link.
Error and warning panels are initialized and hidden unless needed.
TabContainer initializes with two tabs: Placement Selector and Preference History.
If Placement Selector tab is active: UserControl UCPlacementSelector is shown and populated with StudentID, ConfirmedPlacement, and session info.
If Preference History tab is active: UserControl UCPRPreferenceHistory is shown and populated with StudentID, TimetableID, session info; then bound to data.

workflows.name: Validation Workflow
steps: JavaScript function checkRankings validates that rankings choices are unique.
If duplicate values found in ranking dropdowns, args.IsValid is set to false.

workflows.name: UI Workflow for Error/Warning Handling
steps: Error and warning panels are made visible as needed.
User can hide error/warning panels by clicking corresponding buttons which call hideErrorPanel() and hideWarningPanel().

workflows.name: Reset Placement Selector
steps: JavaScript function doPlacementSelectorReset clears and resets all fields related to placement selection.

business_rules: Rankings in placement requests must be unique.
ConfirmedPlacement flag controls visibility and behavior for some controls.
StudentPRPreferenceHistory and StudentPlacementSelector are only shown on their respective tab panels.
validations: UI validation to prevent duplicate ranking values in placement selections.
Input parameters for datasource selection require session and valid StudentID.
conditions: TabContainer1.ActiveTab == TabPanelPlacementSelector: displays PlacementSelector; else hides it.
TabContainer1.ActiveTab == TabPanelPRPreferenceHistory: displays preference history; else hides it.
system_behavior: Page resizes the popup window to fixed dimensions (865x910).
Auto-generated controls managed by ASP.NET Designer and code-behind.
User controls for placement selector and preference history manipulate session and UI visibility.
dependencies: Global resources for UI labels and captions
exceptions: If rankings are not unique, validation fails and user is notified.
If session or StudentID is missing/invalid, datasource selection may fail.
content_gaps: Business logic for actual placement assignment and backend data persistence is not described.
User roles, permissions, and full validation logic for placement requests may be handled elsewhere.
Complete field lists for StudentPlacementSelector and StudentPRPreferenceHistory user controls are not present.
No details on error/warning panel population logic or specific error messages.
